selection.method: Farthest-profile selection over normalized structural and basic-method residual features, then individual coordinate-based editorial notes. Search nodes do not select the tier.

tierBasis: Provisional editorial grouping by residual constraint scope; search nodes are proof cost only.

futoshiki: Horizontal and vertical comparisons work together with six fixed ranks. Combine these range bounds with values excluded by the same row and column, rather than solving each inequality separately.

When a group of cells reserves the same number of possible ranks, keep those ranks out of the other cells of that line. Revisit every crossing comparison after a placement; the basic singles-and-range procedure does not finish this study.
